label: LANTIME M600 high-end NTP time server
description: High-end 1U Stratum-1 NTP server with a 256x64 VFD front panel, disciplining from a GPS/GLONASS satellite receiver or a built-in DCF77/MSF/WWVB radio clock and serving large NTP client populations at high packet rates. Four 10/100 RJ45 ports are standard (ETH0-ETH3), with an option for one 10/100 plus three 10/100/1000 ports; PPS, 10 MHz and the frequency synthesiser are BNC and IRIG/time-code output is BNC.
notes: Meinberg datasheet: 'Network Interface Standard: 4 x 10/100 MBit with RJ45 connector', option '1 x 10/100 MBit and 3 x 10/100/1000 MBit (3GE) with RJ45 jack'. M600 MRS manual labels the rear connectors ETH0-ETH3, 10/100 Mbit RJ45. PTP/IEEE-1588 grandmaster is an option on one port.
